choose.when: SELECT DISTINCT r.person_id FROM residence r JOIN property_unit p ON p.property_unit_id=r.property_unit_id JOIN building_unit bu ON bu.building_unit_id=p.building_unit_id JOIN building b ON b.building_id=bu.building_id WHERE b.community_id=#{targetId} AND r.end_date IS NULL

SELECT DISTINCT r.person_id FROM residence r JOIN property_unit p ON p.property_unit_id=r.property_unit_id JOIN building_unit bu ON bu.building_unit_id=p.building_unit_id WHERE bu.building_id=#{targetId} AND r.end_date IS NULL
SELECT DISTINCT person_id FROM residence WHERE property_unit_id=#{targetId} AND end_date IS NULL
choose.otherwise: SELECT DISTINCT person_id FROM residence WHERE person_id=#{targetId} AND end_date IS NULL

mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notification WHERE sender_account_id=#{accountId}

SELECT n.notification_id,n.title,n.category,n.status,n.sent_at,a.username AS sender_username, COALESCE(SUM(nr.recipient_role='TO'),0) AS to_count,COALESCE(SUM(nr.recipient_role='CC'),0) AS cc_count,COUNT(nr.notification_recipient_id) AS recipient_count FROM notification n JOIN app_account a ON a.account_id=n.sender_account_id LEFT JOIN notification_recipient nr ON nr.notification_id=n.notification_id WHERE n.sender_account_id=#{accountId} GROUP BY n.notification_id,n.title,n.category,n.status,n.sent_at,a.username ORDER BY n.sent_at DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT n.notification_id,n.title,n.content,n.category,n.status,n.sent_at,a.username AS sender_username FROM notification n JOIN app_account a ON a.account_id=n.sender_account_id WHERE n.notification_id=#{notificationId} AND n.sender_account_id=#{accountId}

SELECT nr.person_id,p.full_name,nr.recipient_role FROM notification_recipient nr JOIN person p ON p.person_id=nr.person_id WHERE nr.notification_id=#{notificationId} ORDER BY FIELD(nr.recipient_role,'TO','CC'),p.full_name
